source_priority: Official institution catalogs; catalog year preserved per record

use_limits.catalog_listed: Institution catalog documents a named academic plan and credential; does not verify current application intake.
use_limits.cip2020: Classification of instructional program, not a unique credential or licensing determination.
use_limits.ipeds_historical: Past completions are historical evidence, not current offering verification.
use_limits.admissions_policy: Never infer testing requirements from absent SAT/ACT scores.
use_limits.professional_licensure: Do not infer board approval or individual eligibility from degree name or CIP.

excluded_identity_notes: BMCC NPS-AAS registration-number discrepancy and Queensborough NP-AAS NYSED 00000 are kept out of accepted results.
